## 分诊 · 准入通过 (c) 类

**标签**：`domain:spec` + `domain:ui` · `enhancement` · `needs-user-decision` · `priority:p3` · type `Feature`
`finding` 已摘（定级即离标）。

### 准入判定
- **不可逆窗口**：无。
- **(c) 命中，而且是闭环最完整的一张**：类型声明它 → **设计器把它列出来让人挑** → JSON 校验通过 → 渲染器**一个字都不读**。⇒ 陷阱不是被动存在的，**是被主动推送给作者的**。
- ⭐ `maxResults` 是最锋利的一条：文档写「Maximum number of results to display」，作者对着 50 条列表写 `maxResults: 5`，**得到 50 行，无任何诊断**。`grep` 三处命中里两处是声明和设计器输入，**零个读点**。

### p3，与 #7742 对齐（我考虑过 p2，说明为什么没给）
本卡与 **#7742**（`KanbanSchema` 三个零读点成员 + 一个未声明读点）是**同类同形**，我上一轮给了 #7742 **p3**。优先级衡量的是**单实例严重度**，⛔ 不是实例个数或成员数量。

⚠️ 我确实考虑过因「设计器主动推送五个」而抬到 p2 —— 但 #7742 的 inspector 面也有同样问题，⇒ **抬这张不抬那张会污染优先级轴**。若裁决者认为"设计器推送"这一层应当整体抬档，那应当**两张一起抬**，⛔ 不是单抬本张。

### 为什么是 `needs-user-decision`
enforce-or-remove 两个方向代价不同，且卡片把两边都写清了：
- **Remove**：七个成员 + 设计器输入一起退役 ⇒ **收窄已发布 accept set**，且 `objectName` 在已发布 `.d.ts` 上可见；
- **Enforce**：把 `maxResults` 实现成 slice、把 `objectName`/`fields`/`formId` 接成建议调用的上下文 ⇒ **新增能力**，而卡片明说**目前仓内没有任何东西拉动它们**。

⛔ 本席不裁（`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 要 fable）。

### 边界
- ⚠️ 在裁决落地之前，`packages/plugin-ai/README.md` 里那五个键**仍会被教**（它们是已声明的，所以修好的片段能编译 —— **门禁看得见类型，看不见惰性**）。⇒ 这不是新缺陷，是本卡的下游，⛔ 不要另立文档卡。
- ⛔ 不要与 #7712 / #8171 / #8172 / #8174 混谈：那四张是**渲染器读了但注册表没声明**，本卡是**声明了且推送了但没人读** —— 方向相反。

---

Triage: lands in `packages/types/src/ai.ts` + `packages/plugin-ai/src/index.tsx`; rationale: class (c) — six declared members have zero read sites while the registry advertises five of them to the designer, so an author is actively offered keys the runtime silently drops (`maxResults: 5` still renders 50 rows). Enforce-or-remove needs a ruling.

## Ruling recorded — Remove (director seat, decision batch #78, 2026-09-07)

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「同意」 — presented with Remove recommended.

**Ruling.** Declared = enforced, and nothing pulls on these keys: the seven members are retired — `AIFormAssistSchema.formId` / `objectName` / `fields` / `autoFill` (dead destructure), `AIRecommendationsSchema.objectName` / `maxResults`, `NLQuerySchema.objectName` — together with the five designer inputs `packages/plugin-ai/src/index.tsx` advertises for them, and the `packages/plugin-ai/README.md` examples that teach them. Same direction as ADR-0049 and as the #7742 family (`KanbanSchema`). ⛔ Not Enforce: implementing reads nobody asked for is capability growth without pull; if an AI backend later needs `objectName` / `fields` as context, that is a feature card with its business case.

Execution: `@object-ui/types` accept set narrows on a published `.d.ts` ⇒ per the 2026-08-27 ruling no staged retirement — one step, changeset major-or-minor per the repo's convention for a removed member, `needs:contract-review` on the landing PR (`Clause-②: yes` on the published face). Pins: the seven keys are refused by the schema types (compile-time) and absent from the registry's designer inputs; `AIRecommendations` renders every item and says so in its docblock instead of promising a cap. Triage's note stands: the priority axis is per instance; if the "designer pushes it" layer should lift a grade, #7742 and this card move together.

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`.

## Dispatched R17 — execute the standing **Remove** ruling. ⛔ Not Enforce, ⛔ not reopened.

`domain:spec@objectui` PM seat, 2026-09-09T08:10Z. ⭐ PM dispatch: this seat set the assignee and posts this claim for its dev; the dev inherits both, ⛔ posts no second claim and ⛔ never writes the assignee.

## The ruling — decision batch #78, 2026-09-07, maintainer verbatim 「同意」

Recorded on this card. **Declared = enforced, and nothing pulls on these keys.**

⚠️ **The title says six members. The ruling retires SEVEN** — plus two more surfaces:

| surface | what goes |
|---|---|
| `AIFormAssistSchema` | `formId` · `objectName` · `fields` · `autoFill` (a dead destructure) |
| `AIRecommendationsSchema` | `objectName` · `maxResults` |
| `NLQuerySchema` | `objectName` |
| `packages/plugin-ai/src/index.tsx` | the **five designer inputs** advertising them |
| `packages/plugin-ai/README.md` | the examples that **teach** them |

⛔ **Not Enforce.** The ruling's words: implementing reads nobody asked for is capability growth without pull. If an AI backend later needs `objectName` / `fields` as context, that is a feature card with its own business case.

## Pins the ruling names

- the seven keys are **refused by the schema types** (compile-time), and
- **absent from the registry's designer inputs**, and
- `AIRecommendations` **renders every item and says so in its docblock** instead of promising a cap it never honoured.

## ⚠️ Clause ② is **yes** — and read why, because the general rule would mislead you

A retirement is a *narrowing*, and the general phrasing of clause ② is 「拉回已声明契约不触它」. **That is not the reading here.** The ruling is explicit: *"`@object-ui/types` accept set narrows on a published `.d.ts` ⇒ … `needs:contract-review` on the landing PR (`Clause-②: yes` on the published face)"*. Same shape as objectui#8221's retirement, which was also `yes`.

⇒ Carrier is hung on this card; **hang `needs:contract-review` on the PR the moment one exists** (双载体). ⛔ Do not flip ready, ⛔ do not enqueue — a transcript-verified ceiling review is owed and the PM runs it.

**No staged retirement, no aliases** (the 2026-08-27 ruling): one step. Changeset per the repo's convention for a removed member — ⛔ never `major`; this repo scores its own breaking changes `minor` with the semantics spelled out in the body (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs` enforces it).

## Before you start

⭐ This card **passed the objectui#8410 screen** and the reading is recorded on it (`os-zhuang`, 2026-09-07T19:52Z, `origin/main` `fff250f`). ⛔ That reading is two days old — re-derive the seven members' zero-read status yourself on your own head, each absence with a **firing control**, before deleting anything. A key that acquired a reader since would turn this from a retirement into a regression.

## Standing constraints

⛔ Worktree-first (`/home/user/objectui` is SHARED, other agents are live in it) · ⛔ never `git stash` · ⛔ never kill by name · ⛔ never mutate anything under `node_modules` (pnpm hardlinks from the store) · ⛔ never edit `content/docs/releases/` · run vitest **from the repo root** (objectui#3378) · **exit codes captured BEFORE any pipe** · every zero needs a firing control · ⚠️ `pnpm check` IS a per-PR CI gate (`lint.yml:481`) · ⚠️ your sweep MUST include `apps/console` — excluding it is what reddened PR #8763 in the merge queue.

**`Fixes #8178`** ⇒ this card closes on merge.

## Landed — PR #8796 merged 2026-09-09T10:45:37Z. Card swept.

`domain:spec@objectui` PM seat. Swept: `pm:dispatched` removed, assignee cleared. ⚠️ The `Fixes` close took the card but left every label and the assignee — the 8th occurrence this shift.

### What landed, against the ruling

Decision batch #78 (2026-09-07, maintainer 「同意」): **Remove**. ⚠️ The card's title says six members; the ruling retired **seven**, plus the designer inputs and the README examples — and the delivered PR retired **seven** members and **seven designer input entries** (five distinct names across three registrations).

⭐ **The design call the ruling did not anticipate, and it was measured rather than assumed.** All three AI schemas extend `BaseSchema`, which closes with `[key: string]: any` — so a **deleted** member is silently absorbed at any value, and deletion **cannot** satisfy the ruling's own first pin ("refused by the schema types, compile-time").
